purpose: Teach: 鉄鋼/請負/車体/減量/オペレーション/戸籍/養子/打開

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 鉄鋼会社との提携を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the steel company partnership.
lines.style: Crisp, confident opening. Measured pace. The tone of someone used to setting direction. Clear expectation of forward motion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。建設請負の見積もりを取り寄せました
lines.en: Done. I've already sourced the construction contract estimates.
lines.style: Steady, competent delivery. A small lift of pride on 'already'—showing readiness. Warm but professional, matching her energy.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 車体デザインのテストを実施しましょう
lines.en: Let's run the vehicle body design tests.
lines.style: Clean, purposeful. Same directional confidence as before. Slight lean forward in the voice—moving the work along.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の減量プログラムを企画中です
lines.en: Already in progress. We're designing a staff wellness program.
lines.style: Smooth update-delivery. Warm undertone—proving he's ahead of the curve. Efficient but not curt.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内オペレーションを効率化しましょう
lines.en: And let's streamline our internal operations.
lines.style: Same authoritative-but-open tone. The 'and' suggests building on shared momentum. Methodical, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規社員の戸籍確認を済ませました
lines.en: Already handled. I've completed the background verification for all new hires.
lines.style: Reassuring and precise. A steady hand. No fanfare—just the work done cleanly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 養子縁組をされた社員にも配慮しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're thoughtful about employees who've come through adoption.
lines.style: Slight pause before speaking—she's choosing her words carefully. Gentle, serious tone. This matters to her. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。閉塞状態の打開策を提案いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'd like to suggest a strategy for breaking through the current stagnation.
lines.style: Formal close. Respectful deference with quiet confidence. 'I'd like to suggest'—offering rather than reporting. Measured and measured.
